saved_path_parity_reason: Historical gate, retest, protection and research-input broker paths verified separately. Runtime interfaces repaired and tested locally; fresh deployed execution and ledger audit still required.

entry.boundary: prior20 hourly high for LONG / low for SHORT
entry.touch: completed minute low<=boundary LONG; high>=boundary SHORT
entry.reclaim: completed minute side*(close-boundary)>0 after a touch
entry.fill: next minute action; never fill retrospectively at an unavailable past open
entry.per_token_occupancy: one position; strict admission after prior exit timestamp; reject simultaneous opposite entries

exits.risk_unit: original stop distance at entry; never recalculate R from a tightened stop
exits.floor_price: solve side*(exit-entry)*qty - entry_fee - exit_fee - accrued_funding = .25*original_price_risk*qty; tighten only

paper_cost_reference.funding: Validated paginated settlement rates times settlement-minute open proxy; common cash/protection balance and source timestamp.
paper_cost_reference.stop_fill: sampled actionable price; explicit additional slip assumption if enabled

stale_action.note: t0 is the hourly signal bar's close, which is the first subsequent minute open. The 60 completed minutes are t0 through t0+59. A reclaim schedules the next minute. A quote observed after actionable_window_seconds is rejected as stale_action and is not filled at the missed open. Minutes already closed before this process observed the signal are not backfilled. A missing minute rejects the pending; it is not interpolated.

execution_differences_vs_research_tape.research_sample: minute open, stop checked before target on that open
execution_differences_vs_research_tape.forward_sample: Fresh timestamped quote; completed candles only confirm retests. Entry uses the next-minute action without waiting for its candle to close.
execution_differences_vs_research_tape.forward_entry_and_market_slip: existing CostModel (base 0.001 times the symbol sector multiplier)
execution_differences_vs_research_tape.stop_fill: sampled quote, no second market-exit slip
execution_differences_vs_research_tape.forward_exit_poll: The existing paper worker still polls effective stops about every 15 seconds. That can exit intra-minute versus the research minute-open tape. The poll uses one quote and checks the stop before the target. It does not use a minute high/low to invent which exit came first. Historical fixtures use the minute-open simulator and are not claimed as tape-equivalent.
execution_differences_vs_research_tape.protection_effective: Next UTC minute sample after decision; persisted sample cursor excludes duplicate and historical samples.
execution_differences_vs_research_tape.funding_valuation: Observed settlement rate times settlement-minute open proxy times fixed quantity; same cumulative balance for cash and protection. This is not exact exchange mark-price settlement.
execution_differences_vs_research_tape.funding_missing: No baseline funding estimate for F111/L01. Existing exits remain active; incomplete-at-exit status and observed-through timestamp are recorded.

context_operations.initial_catchup: scripts/prepare_l01_context.py before activation; minute candles only, seed hash checked
context_operations.maintenance: Refresh context at least every4hours using the data-only preparation command. Trading loop only catches up at most8hours for a qualifying long.
context_operations.on_missing_stale_or_busy_context: reject new long and log explicit reason; shorts unchanged
context_operations.on_upgrade: cancel pre-upgrade pending longs; preserve pending shorts and all open-position exits
